scripts/ci/lib/capture-record-contract.mjs validates: the cell's claim, the host it declares,
the FINAL url, the screenshot with its sha256 as it sits on disk, and the anchors that were
counted on that screen with the scope they were counted in.
THE THREE chat_thread RECORDS ARE ALSO REGISTERED IN scripts/ci/chat-hitl-capture-index.json,
which is the file the gate reads. The page_gate_region record is NOT, and the reason is stated
on the record itself: the contract's `review_page` URL class is /^\/agents\/reviews/, while the
shipped gate-region route is /agents/<vendor>/<package>/<runId>/review/<taskId>. The picture is
real and the anchors are real; the CLASS is the thing that does not describe the shipped route,
so registering it would only manufacture a finding nobody can clear by re-photographing.
Every record carries the contract's own verdict on it, verbatim.
